# GitHub Copilot Instructions — HotelDB

Read `AGENTS.md` first. The project contains intentionally missing functionality
for a 90-minute database lecture. Never auto-complete marked `TODO(MISSION-XX)`
without an explicit teacher instruction `ACTIVATE MISSION-XX`.

Do not index `guests.email` until Mission 01 is approved. Do not implement Trie
until students have proposed an algorithm. Do not implement booking changes
until Mission 03 is activated. Do not weaken student read-only database access.
Use prepared tests and show a diff before recommending deployment.
